scope: oxicode-durable execution control plane, SDK composition, Ghost host and conversation CLI
completion_status: Initial runtime and SDK/CLI integration implemented; full pi-durable parity and the Dots product are not complete.

test_breakdown.note: One core case is the subprocess crash helper, which returns immediately in the ordinary suite. Provider tests use mocks or local fixtures; these counts do not establish production readiness.

recovery_scenarios: real process kill during model stream
real process kill after safe tool execution
real process kill after unsafe external effect
real process kill after intent before effect
SQLite transaction failure and session poison
business effect reuse across changed tool call IDs
limitations: Full pi-durable API and behavior parity has not been implemented or verified against the upstream suite.
Live provider requests were not executed.
Existing fixture UI remains on its existing task path; new durable conversations are exposed through SDK and CLI.
The existing multi-profile collaboration path has not been integrated with the new durable conversations.
Execution uses caller-driven bounded steps; a continuous scheduler and long-running production validation remain incomplete.
Execution snapshots rewrite bounded local session JSON; large-scale archival and replication are separate.
Filesystem tools retain the documented local single-user TOCTOU assumptions.
